CREATE TABLE security_observation_capacity (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	capacity INTEGER DEFAULT '100000' NOT NULL, 
	retained BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	overflow BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_security_capacity CHECK (id=1 AND capacity>0 AND retained>=0 AND overflow>=0)
)


CREATE TABLE security_observations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48), 
	key_epoch INTEGER, 
	sequence_number BIGINT, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_security_source CHECK (source IN ('protocol','rule')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_security_category CHECK (category IN ('accepted','replay','rejected','physical_anomaly','delivery_delay')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_security_binding CHECK ((category='rejected' AND device_id IS NULL AND key_epoch IS NULL AND sequence_number IS NULL) OR (category!='rejected' AND device_id IS NOT NULL AND key_epoch>0 AND sequence_number>0))
)

CREATE INDEX ix_security_observation_order ON security_observations (occurred_at, id)

CREATE TABLE policy_admin_audit (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_versions (
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	config JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_worker_status (
	worker_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	diagnostic VARCHAR(80), 
	PRIMARY KEY (worker_id)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48), 
	result JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	compute_ms FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source_lag_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_policy_decision_event UNIQUE (event_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version) REFERENCES policy_versions (version)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_device_states (
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state JSONB NOT NULL, 
	observed_risk VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	recommended JSONB, 
	requested JSONB, 
	applied JSONB, 
	effective_security_state VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'unconfirmed' NOT NULL, 
	configured_profile VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'ascon-aead128-v1' NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (device_id, version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_risk CHECK (observed_risk IN ('NORMAL','WATCH','ALERT','CRITICAL','UNKNOWN')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_no_live_ack CHECK (applied IS NULL AND effective_security_state='unconfirmed'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version) REFERENCES policy_versions (version)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_signals (
	event_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48), 
	source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version) REFERENCES policy_versions (version)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_control_intents (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	command JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_intent_status CHECK (status IN ('proposed','unsupported','expired','failed','simulated')), 
	UNIQUE (decision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decision_id) REFERENCES policy_decisions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_transitions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	from_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	to_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (decision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decision_id) REFERENCES policy_decisions (id)
)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_policy_active ON policy_versions (active) WHERE active IS true
CREATE INDEX ix_policy_decision_history ON policy_decisions (created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_policy_signal_history ON policy_signals (device_id, created_at)
